params.topic: ONLY Japan J1 League 2018-2025: row-level odds interval, fixture crosswalk, and pre-match standings gap recovery
questions: Scope gate: Japan J1 League only, seasons 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025; exclude J2/J3 and all cups. Return scope confirmation first.

For each available fixture, find same-bookmaker earliest verified pre-match and latest verified pre-match 1X2 observations. Keep Bet365, Pinnacle, William Hill separate. Each row must include recorded_at, pre_match_marker, market, home/draw/away, source_url, field_locator, retrieved_at and source_sha256. If unavailable, preserve NULL/unavailable; never relabel closing as opening.

For the 642 known 5DollarFootballAPI unavailable bookmaker fields and 48 unmapped J1 fixture identities, attempt row-level fallback sources and return unique stable keys, bookmaker, phase and exact values only when directly evidenced. Ambiguous rows remain unresolved.

For every J1 fixture, find rank_before, points_before and played_before from a dated pre-kickoff or previous-round snapshot. Do not use final standings or API-Football season snapshots as pre-match values. Mark first-round rank, tied-rank ambiguity and unverified snapshot timing as unavailable.
Do not infer or return qimen_output, Qimen palaces, F relation, G energy, I cycle/intent, Miss labels, probabilities or outcome-derived fields.
